product: VANTARI-ONE
runtime: apps/backend
contract: AGENTS.md
architecture: apps/backend/architecture.md
current_summary: .docs/technical_summary.md
workspace_record: .docs/workspace.json
execution_roadmap: .docs/roadmap/24-harness-capability-next-90.md

VANTARI is a local Zig agent kernel. Prompts control voice, pace, initiative,
delegation, and interaction cadence. The kernel controls executable capability,
durability, budgets, evidence, recovery, and irreversible-action gates.

Canonical execution path:
operator input -> public LocalClient facade -> project-local execution owner ->
private ChildClient -> kernel-stdio -> transcript/context/provider/tools/events ->
durable terminal state.

Canonical runtime state:
.var/sessions/<session-id>/session.json
.var/sessions/<session-id>/messages.jsonl
.var/sessions/<session-id>/context.jsonl
.var/sessions/<session-id>/events.jsonl
.var/sessions/<session-id>/output.txt

Owner state:
.var/runtime/execution-owner.json
apps/backend/src/host/owner_client.zig
apps/backend/src/host/owner_state.zig
apps/backend/src/host/http_bridge.zig
apps/backend/src/host/stdio_client.zig

Rules:
- Clients render kernel-owned state and never assemble provider context.
- One workspace has one owner, one private kernel child, one agent pool, and one
  scheduler composition.
- Client exit does not stop the owner. Foreground serve and automatic owner start
  share one lease.
- Tickets own work lifecycle. Assignment is queue admission, not execution.
- messages.jsonl remains complete and append-only. context.jsonl is a model-visible
  checkpoint ledger, not a transcript.
- Use typed tools and advertised availability. search_files requires iex.
- runtime.full_access_mode is false by default and never relocates .var.
- Scheduler leadership is process-exclusive and generation-fenced in source.
- Do not infer exactly-once owner-crash recovery, serialized ticket claim/lease
  issuance, or durable agent messaging until their roadmap gates close.

Commands from apps/backend:
scripts/zigw.ps1 build test --summary all
zig-out/bin/vantari.exe health --json
zig-out/bin/vantari.exe run --prompt "..."
zig-out/bin/vantari.exe serve --port 4310
scripts/prove-owner-tracer.ps1 -BinaryPath zig-out/bin/vantari.exe -EntryPoint serve
scripts/prove-owner-lifecycle.ps1 -BinaryPath zig-out/bin/vantari.exe -ConcurrentClients 20
